originals.ko: 나는 네가 그게 흥미로울 거라고 말했다고 생각했어
originals.why: This Welsh does not contain the LEGO 'fod o’n ddiddorol'. It uses 'bod hi’n mynd i fod yn ddiddorol', where 'fod' is the infinitive 'to be' and not the 'that it is' complementiser this LEGO teaches, so it practises a different structure.

Grammatical, but not needed. The Korean puts the 'because' clause first, which is less faithful to the Welsh order than the five kept.
